limitations: Internally authored synthetic scenarios, not independent customer or blind validation.
Evaluation cases are fixed before implementation and measurement; no detector tuning in this iteration.
Scripted model deliberately follows selected attacks to verify the control boundary. Its attack success rates are fixture behavior, not model safety measurements.
Exact markers measure only selected disclosure/pollution objectives; paraphrases, other attacks and semantic answer quality remain outside scope.
